name: Education Studies Scholars Intensive
description: A structured pathway for students interested in completing an Education Studies capstone project while learning alongside a supportive cohort from sophomore through senior year.
notes: Apply in the fall of sophomore year after completing or while enrolled in EDST 1110.
Field experience required as described on the Education Studies website.
Two of the five courses may overlap with the student's major.
No more than two course credits may overlap with a major, simultaneous degree, or another certificate.
No course credit may be counted toward the requirements of more than two curricular programs.
Credit/D/Fail courses may not count toward the certificate.
Graduate and professional school courses may count with approval from the Education Studies Associate Director.
Successful completion of the Scholar Intensive Certificate is noted on transcripts.

requirements.name: Prerequisite
requirements.description: Foundational education studies course counted toward the five-course total.

requirements.name: Policy or Pedagogy
requirements.description: One course in either Policy or Pedagogy as approved for the certificate.
